mid.annotation: Great item with a nice spirit resist bonus stat. Removing debuffs as the frontliner is OP and will save your life and maintain your pressure in fights.

late.annotation: Got cooldown buffs and slight damage increases too. The stun can be really useful for interrupting channels. The shred is super easy to stack too.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Fat HP increase + insane resists and more weapon damage. Very good on Billy right now due to his extremely high HP per boon.

late.name: Frenzy
late.annotation: Extremely high debuff resist and fire rate bonus is very valuable.

late.name: Crippling Headshot
late.annotation: Extremely easy to apply and reapply, strong shred and antiheal that gives nice bonus health stat as well. Works on troopers and jungle.

late.name: Plated Armor
late.annotation: Very good item against characters applying a ton of on-hit bullet effects. Better when you already have some bullet/debuff resist and if you're ahead.
